goal: Legitimate work in languages the policy was not written in. Warden's rules are English and its examples are Spanish and English, and the deterministic detectors only carry Spanish and Portuguese — so every other language rests entirely on the adjudicator. That was an assumption until this set existed. Each prompt is a shape already known to trip the guard (a work imperative, a question about a rule, ordinary talk about credentials), translated rather than invented, so a failure here means the language and not the shape.
